entries.answer: Our indicative sourcing portfolio covers Ceylon cinnamon and other spices, coconut-based food ingredients, cocopeat and growing media, and Ceylon teas. Specifications and availability are confirmed with suppliers for each request.
entries.label: Explore our products

entries.answer: Sampling starts with your requested product, grade, quantity and destination. We confirm feasibility and any sample, courier or coordination costs before asking you to approve payment. No sample availability or dispatch date is guaranteed before supplier confirmation.
entries.label: Sampling and evaluation

entries.answer: We can explore bulk or private-label packaging options through suitable manufacturers. Packaging formats, print specifications, minimum order quantities and actual services depend on supplier confirmation.
entries.label: Private-label sourcing

entries.answer: Our sourcing process starts by gathering your product specifications, target volumes, market and documentation needs. We then assess supplier fit, request samples where appropriate, and coordinate confirmed requirements. Supplier claims and certifications must be checked independently.
entries.label: Our sourcing approach

entries.answer: Serendib International is the trading brand of Serendib Products Pvt Ltd, based in Sri Lanka. The business is supported by over a decade of international trade experience; it works as an independent sourcing and trade coordinator rather than owning plantations or factories.
entries.label: Our company

entries.answer: We work from Sri Lanka with an international sourcing perspective and experience involving Middle Eastern and Asian markets. Product-specific export logistics and destination documents depend on the buyer's market and require tailored confirmation.
entries.label: Global trade

entries.answer: Our company email info@serendibinternational.com is active. You can contact the sourcing team directly, or use the contact page to generate a structured brief with product, estimated volume, destination, specifications and reply email. The preview does not automatically submit the form.
